title: General-purpose opportunity emergence (the repair-discovery wave)
source: The TL progress review of 2026-10-29: P21 is closed with substantial verified progress, but the opportunity-emergence objective is NOT implemented — the conditional derivation recognizes exactly one hardcoded corridor pattern (FLW-wallet funding declined by a Stripe receiving rail), the general discovery engine / platform work items / multi-hop hypotheses / model-assisted exploration do not exist, and no E2E receipt asserts the conditional opportunities are displayed to the user as actionable alternatives (PinnedConditionalOpportunity has zero consumers; the product adapter never calls deriveConditionalOpportunities; stage 6 runs structurally empty; the wait-recheck composition is never booted).
policy: Register only. No P23 implementation or acceptance is claimed by the graph. P23 registers BESIDE P22 (the operator's provider-combination redo — Stellar/Stripe/Flutterwave/Paystack — which is NOT redefined, NOT blocked and NOT silently merged into this wave; ADR-0015 D1). The P21-0 §3 D4 informal note that named the CLI-agent skill/MCP integration as a 'P23 candidate' is reconciled: that scope moves to the P24 candidate list. The review's seven requirement rows are the acceptance basis: generalize the exclusion-to-repair mapping; add a typed repair-operator catalogue; generate explicit platform/integration work items with evidence; generate hypothetical graphs and re-run the real planner over their verified legs; add a bounded, grounded model-proposal interface with strict validation; keep financial execution deterministic; present opportunities to the user as actionable cards and prove the full journey in Electron and web. The frozen laws this wave preserves: the nine-shape route vocabulary UNCHANGED (the P21-0 C8 law — the cross-provider fiat composition stays the named platform work item); the Lab intervention vocabulary UNCHANGED (the discipline extends, the INV-L01 package boundary does not cross); the host shell UNCHANGED (no new members — the wait-recheck observations source maps from the existing connectionCapabilityChains member); the six truth facts stay machine-enforced; the P21 corridor behavior is byte-identical (the compat gate — the existing conditional-stage tests and the P21 bridge assertions stay green unmodified); no model output can bypass the deterministic planner, security policy or financial authorization gates (the no-bypass battery is a named closure gate); web stays honest (the unbound notes); no live-model claim without a configured model (the empty deployment renders the honest unbound note).

closure_policy: P23 closes only when P23-A/B/C/D are all accepted on main with their batteries green at the tip AND the review's user journey is proven end-to-end: the no-route state explains WHY (the typed exclusions), the repairs are DISPLAYED as actionable cards (CDP desktop + web evidence with card-content assertions — never satisfied by the scenarios-digest list), multiple meaningfully different repairs are distinguishable (a party change, a platform work item, a multi-hop hypothesis), verified options are distinguished from unverified hypotheses, the sender/merchant/third-party/PaySwap-platform changes are each shown, the opportunities persist and recheck over fresh observations, and the no-bypass battery proves that no model output, conditional, hypothesis or platform work item can bypass the deterministic planner, the security policy or the financial authorization gates. A documentation-only or test-count-only wave cannot close P23. P22's scope is untouched by this closure.
